entries.en:
Haermaga is inordinately proud of his take on traditional demon-slaying exhibitions, and would like you to man the cannons down in the Salt Strand. Seek out the Moonfire Faire chaperone Mayaru Moyaru down in lower La Noscea─you are sure to have a blast.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Mayaru Moyaru insists on explaining some basic safety rules before he allows you near a cannon. As the representative of the guild, both masterful aim and noble conduct are expected of you. Speak with Mayaru Moyaru when you are ready to begin.
entries.fr: On vous a demandé d'en mettre plein la vue aux petits et grands Éorzéens à coups de canon. Reparlez à Mayaru Moyaru pour commencer à tirer sur tout ce qui bouge !
entries.ja: 紅蓮祭の催し「ギルド砲兵隊、実演！」の説明を受けた。会場には子どもたちが集まり、華麗な実演を渇望している。「紅蓮祭実行委員マヤル・モヤル」に再び声をかけ、カノン砲を使った魔物退治を開始しよう。

entries.en: Hah, ready to churn it up? I named this event myself─named all of 'em, but the other two got shot down by other chaperones. But this one was a winner! I call it “The Cannon-do Spirit”!
entries.macro: Hah, ready to churn it up? I named this event myself─named all of 'em, but the other two got shot down by other chaperones. But this one was a winner! I call it “The Cannon<-->do Spirit”!
entries.fr: Que dirais-tu d'ébahir la populace avec un grand boum ? Le spectacle “Beau comme un canon !” va faire parler de lui, je te le dis !

あんたには「ギルド砲兵隊、実演！」って催しを、
手伝ってもらいたい。

entries.en: Demon slaying's always a crowd pleaser, but parents of little ones can be a mite touchy about the hacking and slashing. What I figured is, you need to keep it dry.
entries.macro: Demon slaying's always a crowd pleaser, but parents of little ones can be a mite touchy about the hacking and slashing. What I figured is, you need to keep it <italic(1)>dry<italic(0)>.
entries.fr: Un bon massacre plaît toujours au public, mais les parents ont parfois de drôles d'idées sur ce qu'on peut montrer ou pas à leurs enfants, et démembrer des ennemis à coup d'épée est considéré comme inapproprié...
entries.ja:
知ってのとおり冒険者ギルドの受ける仕事は、
製作や採集に始まり、多岐に渡っているが……
魔物から人々を守ることも重要な使命だ。

entries.en: So we decided to use cannons instead. More civilized-like and crispy, was my way of thinking. That's why I sit in the big chair, I fancy. Family friendly, that's what I am.
entries.fr: Alors on s'est dit que les exploser à coup de canon allait satisfaire les petits comme les grands !
entries.ja:
そこでいっちょ、カノン砲をぶっぱなして、
わかりやすく魔物退治を実演してやろうって寸法よ。

entries.en: Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have cannons? Weeell, I never could resist something complimentary, and the Maelstrom was─what do you call it?─decommissioning a few. They're safe enough. You've seen their like along the parapets of Aleport.
entries.macro: Since when does the Adventurers' Guild have cannons? Weeell, I never could resist something complimentary, and the Maelstrom was─what do you call it?─<italic(1)>decommissioning<italic(0)> a few. They're safe enough. You've seen their like along the parapets of Aleport.
entries.fr: Depuis quand la guilde a-t-elle des canons ? Eh bien, le Maelstrom a récemment vendu à bas prix certains de ses canons, ceux dont la compagnie ne se sert plus. Ils sont sans danger, pour le canonnier s'entend. Ils sont identiques à ceux placés sur le parapet de Port-aux-Ales.
entries.ja:
……ん？　冒険者ギルドにカノン砲なんぞあったかって？
いや最近、黒渦団から安く払い下げてもらったんだよ。
エールポートの胸壁に並んでるのと似たようなやつだ。

entries.fr: Le spectacle va avoir lieu près des atolls de sel. Va voir Mayaru Moyaru là-bas, il te donnera de plus amples informations.

entries.en: Someone who does all three events─now that's what I call an adventurer! Loves the trade, ready for a bit o' fun, never stingy with  guild. An adventurer like that gets a special reward out of my own purse!

entries.en: Ahoy, welcome to, um, the cannon event! I like to think of this as an exhibition that packs a real punch. And also family friendly─look at all the little ones in the audience!
entries.fr: Bienvenue, bienvenue ! Vous êtes ici pour participer à la démonstration de tir au canon ? C'est un spectacle de bon goût, pas un bain de sang susceptible d'effrayer les enfants !
entries.ja:
ようこそ、「ギルド砲兵隊、実演！」の会場へ！
ここでは魔物退治の実演をやってるよ。
ほら、ちいさなお客さんもあんなに集まってる！

entries.en: The chief chaperone told you what you'd be up to, yes? Demon slaying, and lots of it! We've acquired some nice 18-ponze cannons. They make a big bang when they're fired at their targets─sabotenders and womandragoras in this case!
entries.fr: Notre organisateur en chef vous a tout expliqué, je présume ? Je vais vous demander d'exploser des cibles dans un gros boum avec des .
entries.ja:
どんな催しかは、委員長から聞いているね？
会場に設置したカノン砲……「」を、
標的の魔物にドカンとぶっぱなすんだ！

entries.en: And don't go hitting anything other than your intended targets! I think it's been mentioned once or twice that this is a family-friendly event.
entries.fr: Mais faites attention à bien viser ! N'allez pas toucher les autres aventuriers qui participent, notre jeune audience pourrait être traumatisée !
entries.ja:
会場には人がたくさんいるから、よく狙って撃ってね。
ほかの冒険者さんに当てちゃだめだよ！

entries.en: I mean...it's not as though someone would die or anything if one were to accidentally get a blast to the face. But a cannonball is still far from a flan puff. I shouldn't think it would be safe.
entries.macro: I mean...it's not as though someone would <italic(1)>die<italic(0)> or anything if one were to accidentally get a blast to the face. But a cannonball is still far from a flan puff. I shouldn't think it would be safe.
entries.fr: Nous avons certes réduit la puissance de l'artillerie pour éviter les accidents fatals, mais vous pourriez tout de même blesser quelqu'un.
entries.ja:
えっと……その……なんていうか……
一応、誤射に備えて、火力は抑えてあるから。
大丈夫、直撃されても死なないよ……多分。

entries.en: Besides, it would be in extremely poor taste to shoot any future adventurers with the cannon. We can't have them thinking ill of the guild. And it certainly wouldn't be family friendly!
entries.macro: Besides, it would be in extremely poor taste to shoot any future adventurers with the cannon. We can't have them thinking ill of the guild. And it <italic(1)>certainly<italic(0)> wouldn't be family friendly!
entries.fr: Alors surtout, ne faites pas n'importe quoi, même pour plaisanter. Le but est d'impressionner les spectateurs, ne l'oubliez pas !
entries.ja:
……だからって、ふざけて友だちに当てたりしないでね！
いいね、絶対にわざと当てないでね……ぜったいだよ！

entries.en: Now, please think on everything I've said. If you decide you'd like to play by the rules, simply speak with me to participate.
